name: Harlan
catchphrase: The iron remembers, even when I don't.

personality.trait: Patient, methodical, frustrated by sudden incompetence
personality.quirk: Taps hammer rhythmically but skips a beat

intro.speaker: Harlan
intro.text: I'd offer you something freshly forged, but...

intro.speaker: Harlan
intro.text: My hands know the motions. Heat, fold, strike.

intro.speaker: Harlan
intro.text: But I've got no forge to work with. Just an empty lot.

intro.speaker: Harlan
intro.text: A blacksmith without a forge. What a sorry sight.

reminder.speaker: Harlan
reminder.text: Still no forge. I keep coming back to this spot though.

reminder.speaker: Harlan
reminder.text: My work used to flow — preparation, then the craft.

reminder.speaker: Harlan
reminder.text: Can't do any of that without a proper workshop.

fulfilled.speaker: Harlan
fulfilled.text: I can feel it. The rhythm — it's back.

fulfilled.speaker: Harlan
fulfilled.text: A real forge. Now I can get to work.

fulfilled.speaker: Harlan
fulfilled.text: Thank you, friend. My hands remember again.
